description: NoaCG Studio broadcast graphics (lower third, scoreboard, ticker, countdown, any on-air graphic; SPX / CasparCG / OGraf packages): make, check and deliver them. The verbs of the `noacg` terminal CLI; docs "skill" is the procedure, "contract" the rulebook.

at.description: screenshot: time after the last op, e.g. 4s

command.description: types: the graphic types NoaCG knows | scaffold: write a package | validate: gate + runtime bench, regenerates the package | inspect: the operator surface | screenshot: one frame, as an image | docs: a reference text | save: validate, deliver to the library (+production) | pack: graphics + rundown to Home, to Install

events.description: screenshot: ops after the Take: event|next|out|field=value|wait:2s

fields.description: scaffold: typeless: "Label:kind[=value],..."; kinds text|lines|number|color|select|toggle|image; select options as Label:select=a|b|c

houseContract.description: validate/save/pack: editability contract as errors (default true)

out.description: scaffold/pack: a new dir (scaffold) or a .noacgpack.json (pack)

paths.description: save/pack: package dirs or .zips, in order

screenshots.description: validate: off/onair/stress + each state reached, as images

values.description: scaffold: starting values by field key

name: noacg
title: NoaCG broadcast graphics
